record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PSYSHIELD_BASH: Stantler (3 stars, passive STANTLER) and Wyrdeer (4 stars, no passive); both range 1, maxPP 100. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the damage table. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs a target in range (inherited requiresTarget = true). Asks the board helper for a destination (the free cell next to the farthest targettable enemy, chosen by Manhattan distance, not necessarily the cast target). If a destination exists, the enemies standing on the supercover line from the caster's current cell to that destination are collected (before the caster moves), then the caster moves there with moveTo (not forced displacement). Regardless of whether a destination existed, the caster then gets Protect for a fixed 1000 ms (no AP or crit scaling; ignored if already protected or enraged). If no enemy was collected, the cast target is added so it is always hit. Each collected enemy takes requested SPECIAL damage 50 (Stantler, 3 stars) / 60 (Wyrdeer, 4 stars) (table 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 120, fallback 120) via handleSpecialDamage with the caster as attacker and the cast's crit flag (crit needs ABILITY_CRIT).

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity standing on the cells between the caster and the helper's destination (both endpoints included); the cast target only as fallback when none was collected
targeting.note: The destination comes from the helper's scan of targettable enemies, not from the cast target. The destination is a free cell, so no enemy stands on it; the caster's own cell is on the line but filtered out as same-team. Cells are read before the caster moves.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's starting cell to the destination cell chosen by the helper

effects.target: each collected enemy (once per enemy, set semantics)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] ?? 120. handleSpecialDamage multiplies by (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true), x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE, x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT, and on a crit by 1 + (critPower - 1) x the target's crit reduction factor (Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite). Crit needs ABILITY_CRIT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers, handed to PokemonState.handleDamage: divided by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef of the target), rounded up with a minimum of 1, absorbed first by the target's shield. takenDamage (not stored by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage capped at current HP; 0 for a protected / skydiving / Magic Bounce target. Requested, applied and takenDamage are three different amounts. The damage is dealt after the caster moved, so the caster's own protect does not affect it.

declaredRaw.description: moveTo the destination chosen by getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: moveTo(x, y, board, false): toMovingState, board.swapCells (the destination is free, so the caster just changes cell), cooldown = 100 for faster retargeting; canBeMoved is checked only for forced displacement, so it is not consulted. No move when the helper returns null (no targettable enemy or no free cell).

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit (a fixed 1000)
effects.resolution: triggerProtect(1000): ignored when the caster is already protected (no refresh) or enraged; otherwise protect = true and protectCooldown = 1000, cleared by updateProtect. While protected the caster takes 0 from basic and ability damage and cannot gain positive PP or ordinary healing (status.protect, not Rune Protect; core-mechanics.md section J). Applied whether or not a destination was found.

statusEffects.resolution: not stackable, not applied to an enraged caster

starBehavior.note: Only the damage depends on stars (index stars-1 of the casting entity). Protect duration and destination logic are star-independent. 30 / 40 (1-2 stars) and 120 (5 stars / fallback) are not reached by the listed units at their factory star counts. Whether other mechanics change a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Selection in board.ts:568-630 (same helper as FLAME_CHARGE, NUZZLE and AQUA_JET): board.forEach scans cells row by row; only targettable enemies whose Manhattan distance from the caster is strictly greater than the running maximum are considered, so equal distances keep the first one scanned. For such an enemy the running cell maximum is reset and its free adjacent cells are compared by distance from the caster, the first strictly farther one winning; selectedCell is replaced only when that enemy has at least one free adjacent cell, so if a farther enemy has none, the cell chosen for an earlier, nearer enemy is retained (and that enemy is the helper's target). The fallback (the free cell closest by Manhattan distance to the farthest enemy, anywhere on the board, possibly not adjacent) runs only if selectedCell is still null at the end. If the helper returns null the caster does not move and only the cast target is hit.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repositions the caster again; a cast while Protect is still active does not refresh it.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 50 (STANTLER) / 60 (WYRDEER) and a fixed 1000 ms Protect. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) x DOUBLE_DAMAGE x steam x crit factor; applied after speDef, minimum 1 and shield; takenDamage = shield + HP part. Protect: requested 1000 ms, applied only when the caster is neither protected nor enraged.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, target acquisition for a requiresTarget ability) - only the castAbility gate was read

What the STANTLER passive does: Passive.STANTLER appears only in the Stantler class and the Passive enum in app/ (git grep at the pinned commit), with no handler found there; any effect elsewhere is not covered
unresolved: How common the retained-selectedCell case is on real boards was not examined; the same helper nuance applies to FLAME_CHARGE, NUZZLE and AQUA_JET
Whether the caster can already stand on a cell with an enemy-free line (e.g. destination equal to current cell) was not examined
Whether the two units reach a different star count than the factory value (Stantler evolves to Wyrdeer through a state-based rule) was not examined
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
